interface.longDescription: SyncFlo AI lets you inspect and manage your WhatsApp business operations from ChatGPT, including leads, conversations, campaigns, orders, product catalogue, knowledge base, AI agents, analytics, and account usage. It only accesses data in the SyncFlo account you connect. Write, send, and delete actions are limited by the permissions granted to your connection, and high-impact actions such as sending messages or deleting records require confirmation.
